text: Then I'll cooperate. For what it's worth. Just... in whatever you write, say I didn't know at the start. Please.
style: Security consultant in his late thirties, exhausted and frightened. Speak with a consistent East Midlands (Nottingham) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Mid-range pitch that tightens and rises under stress; quiet, quick pace. Quick to explain himself, close to tears without ever quite getting there.
